faq.title: Before you start
faq.desc: If your question isn't here, send a request through the form and our team will get back to you.

remote.question: Can an employee check in from home?
remote.answer: No. Each branch has a geofence on the map, and check-ins are only accepted inside it with a selfie — unless you allow remote work for a specific employee.

tracking.question: Does tracking run all the time?
tracking.answer: Tracking only runs during working hours, from check-in to check-out. After check-out the employee's location isn't tracked at all.

devices.question: Do we need fingerprint devices or special hardware?
devices.answer: No. Employees use their own phones (Android or iPhone), and management uses the dashboard from any browser.

offline.question: Does the app work on a weak connection?
offline.answer: Check-ins are saved on the phone and uploaded as soon as the connection is back, with the original time and location.

payroll.question: Can we export payroll reports?
payroll.answer: Yes — a monthly report per employee with days present, lateness, absence and leave, exportable to Excel.

setup.question: How long does setup take?
setup.answer: Our team sets up your company account with branches, shifts and employees, and your employees can start the same day.
